title: Pin the six hand-copied terminal-phase memberships with a parity suite
action: Per E5, write a NEW suite scripts/tests/test_terminal_phase_parity.mjs and register it in scripts/run_verify.mjs's suite list. The literal set ['idle','compounding-complete'] is hand-copied verbatim in six modules under three names, none importing KNOWN_PHASES and none cross-checked: TERMINAL_PHASES at lib/guards.mjs:151, lib/compaction.mjs:81, lib/scratch.mjs:62; NO_WORK_PHASES at lib/inject.mjs:235, lib/intent.mjs:49; TERMINAL_LANE_PHASES at lib/recovery.mjs:40. VERIFY EACH LOCATION YOURSELF before asserting on it -- line numbers shift. Assert the six agree with each other and are consistent with KNOWN_PHASES from lib/state.mjs, and on drift name the offending file:line rather than just reporting inequality; a parity failure whose message does not say WHICH copy moved costs the reader the whole investigation. Derive the set of locations rather than hardcoding six paths if you can do so honestly -- a hardcoded list of the very thing being checked for drift is the defect this suite exists to catch, one level up. Do NOT refactor the six to derive from the enum: each carries its own semantics layered on the shared list, and E5 deliberately defers that. Check both the canonical packages/bee copies and their .bee/bin twins.
